name: Cinemark
desc:
The Fandango Method
After buying the gift card:
1. Go to Fandango.com
2. Select a CINEMARK ONLY THEATER
3. Go to checkout, press “Use Giftcard or Promo Code”
4. Select Cinemark Giftcard
5. Apply and enjoy your online checkout
6.CASHOUT METHOD ORDER ON FANDANGO LATE WITH THE GIFTCARD
SHOW UP LATE THEY WILL GIVE YOU CASH REFUND 
Cinemark Credits Method

1. Open the Cinemark app or go to cinemark.com and log in 
2. Go to checkout when buying tickets or concessions 
3. Your available credits will show automatically 
4. Select “apply credits” to use them 
5. Each credit covers one regular 2D ticket 
6. For premium formats (XD, 3D, IMAX), pay the small upcharge 
7. Complete your purchase—online fees are waived for members 

Note: Credits can also buy snacks at concessions—just scan your QR code at checkout

name: Hertz
desc:
Hertz Points Method (Simple)
1. Go to Hertz.com or open the app and log in 
2. Enter your rental location, dates, and times 
3. Check the box that says “Use my Hertz Gold Plus Rewards points” 
4. Pick your car
5. Review the total (points cover base rate—taxes and fees you pay separate) 
6. Complete the reservation
7. Pick up and enjoy the free rental
